## Episode Thesis

This is a sponsored segment (a paid ad for Societe Generale, not DI editorial content) explaining exchange-traded products (ETPs): tracker certificates, Bull & Bear certificates, mini futures and short products. It covers leverage mechanics, daily rebalancing and volatility decay, issuer counterparty risk, market making and costs. Companies come up only as examples or distribution channels, and no investment view is given on any stock.
